timeline.summary: Q1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹203.82 Cr (+42.6% YoY), net profit ₹8.32 Cr (against a loss of ₹0.37 Cr a year earlier).
Orient Bell released its Q1FY27 investor presentation highlighting a 42.6% YoY revenue increase and expansion in EBITDA margins.
Orient Bell submitted the audio recording link for its Q1FY27 post-earnings call on August 11, 2026.
Orient Bell Limited’s 49th AGM on August 11, 2026, passed all nine resolutions with shareholder approval via remote e-voting (record date: July 24, 2026).
Orient Bell invested ₹1.07 Cr for 1.00 MW wind solar hybrid power supply at its Dora plant, enabling renewable energy usage across all three manufacturing plants.
